rationale: B is more idiomatic and a bit more robust. It computes the modular inverse with the built-in pow(a, -1, M) rather than A's hand-written search loop. Its flat isalpha/isdigit branches are cleaner than A's nested isalnum-then-isdigit check. It also lowercases characters in decode, so uppercase ciphertext works, while A's decode would produce garbage for capital letters. B has one wart: it re-evaluates "".join(chars) for every chunk inside the grouping generator, which is wasteful. A avoids that by joining once. On balance B's cleaner logic and better handling of input case make it the better solution.
